text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah-ha-ha-ha, Happy Birthday!! I'll put 
my feelings into a soooong~~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on a second! I'm pretty sure I 
heard more than enough of your singing 
back in the room...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That was just Act One! My feelings of 
celebration for Hayahide-san won't end 
with just that!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Following up with Act Two: 'What a 
Beautiful Room' ~Why is the Conqueror's 
room always so pristine? It's all thanks 
to you, Hayahide-san~--!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...That's only because you're always 
leaving your roses and vanity table lying 
around!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And Act Three: "Knowest Thou the Southern 
Fruit, O Conqueror?" —From baked goods to 
curry, that love for bananas shall lead me 
to new horizons of flavor—!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"T-That's only because you said you 
couldn't eat large portions, so I selected 
ingredients with high nutritional 
efficiency――"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And for the grand finale, "Can't Help 
Loving This Dorm Life" ~Oh, My Dearest 
Roommate~—!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
How's that!? A special performance packed 
to the brim with all my gratitude! And 
love!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I see. Truly, every one of these 
songs feels as though it was composed with 
deep thoughts of me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If so, I'd like to hear all about it in 
detail. Let's save the rest for when we're 
back in the dorm room.
